research.searchCoverage: Official Reply API v3 Bearer token (Settings → API Key), GET /v3/whoami, contacts, sequences, email-accounts, contact-lists, and schedules reviewed against Composio Reply.io tools. US/Canada operator. This is not a breach-free claim.

Official Reply v3 Bearer auth, GET /v3/whoami, contacts, sequences, email accounts, contact lists, and schedules. Empty-body 401. US/Canada operator. No current unresolved Reply.io API compromise is asserted.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /v3/whoami. Native category is crm (source Marketing/Communication are not in the Rust CATEGORIES allowlist). Content-Type is omitted on GET (pinned source always sets it).
Extra official GET /v3/whoami/team-users. This is not REPLY_IO_DELETE_USER; OpenAPI has no /v3/users delete.
Returns the raw team-users JSON array under data.

Optional top (1–1000), skip, and email bind to documented query names, not $top/$skip or Composio page/limit. LIST_CONTACTS_BASIC stays this operation; SEARCH_CONTACTS is contacts.search with required email. LinkedIn lookup is omitted. Returns raw Reply JSON under data instead of {contacts, hasMore}.
SEARCH_CONTACTS is a dedicated GET /v3/contacts with required email. LIST_CONTACTS_BASIC stays contacts.list with optional email.
Returns raw Reply JSON under data.
id is a URL-encoded numeric path segment. Returns raw Reply JSON under data instead of {contact}.
POST /v3/contacts uses official field names (linkedInUrl, timeZoneId, companySize PascalCase). Composio linkedInProfile/timeZone aliases are not accepted because unused-input forbids them.
PATCH /v3/contacts/{id} uses official field names. customFields patch items are id/name/value per OpenAPI, not key/value.
DELETE /v3/contacts/{id} returns empty 204. Mapped onto pinned update_contact because pinned actions have no delete_contact.
POST /v3/contacts/{id}/move-to-sequence uses official path id (not Composio contact_id) and returns empty 204.
GET /v3/contacts/{id}/statuses. Composio sequenceId is omitted because the official path has no sequence filter.
POST /v3/contacts/set-status-in-sequence uses official statusInSequence enum active|paused|finished|outOfOffice. Composio OptedOut/Replied/Bounced/Called/ToCall/MeetingBooked use other endpoints.
POST /v3/contacts/set-opted-out with constant isOptedOut=false. Composio CLEAR_CONTACT_STATUS multi-status clear is partial coverage of opt-out only.
Optional top, skip, and name bind to documented query names. Composio page/limit are omitted. Returns raw Reply JSON under data instead of {sequences, hasMore}.
id is a URL-encoded numeric path segment. Returns raw Reply JSON under data instead of {sequence}.
POST /v3/sequences/{id}/start has an empty body. Content-Type is omitted.
POST /v3/sequences/{id}/pause has an empty body. Content-Type is omitted.
POST /v3/sequences/{id}/archive has an empty body. Mapped onto pinned pause_sequence.
DELETE /v3/sequences/{id} returns empty 204.
GET /v3/sequences/{id}/steps returns a JSON array under data.
POST /v3/sequences/{id}/steps uses official lowercase type and variants (not Composio templates). executionMode is automatic|manual.
GET /v3/sequences/{id}/steps/{step_id} uses official path names id and step_id.
GET /v3/sequences/{id}/contacts/state with official top (max 100), skip, and additionalColumns.
DELETE /v3/sequences/{id}/contact-links/{contact_id} returns empty 204. Path names match official OpenAPI.
POST /v3/sequences/{id}/contact-links/bulk-delete with official contactIds array.
GET /v3/email-accounts with official top/skip/my. Composio page/limit/status are omitted because they are unused on this path.
Official GET /v3/email-accounts/connect/gmail returns 302 Location to Google's consent screen. Maps to REPLY_IO_CONNECT_GMAIL_ACCOUNT.

Declarative compile follows redirects and the runner blocks outbound 302s, so the connector overlay in src/actions.ts uses input.fetch with redirect:manual and returns {data:{location}} from the Location header.
Official GET /v3/email-accounts/connect/office-365 returns 302 Location to Microsoft's consent screen. Maps to REPLY_IO_CONNECT_EXCHANGE_ACCOUNT.
Overlay in src/actions.ts uses input.fetch with redirect:manual, same as connect_gmail.
POST /v3/email-accounts/filter with constant body {status: disconnected} plus optional top/skip.
PATCH /v3/email-accounts/{id} uses official nested connection/safety/signature/optOut/rampUp/tags. Composio flat smtpHost fields map into connection.
DELETE /v3/email-accounts/{id} returns empty 204. id is an integer, not a Composio string.
GET /v3/contact-lists with official top/skip/search.
DELETE /v3/schedules/{id} returns empty 204. id is an integer.
Local Crockford-base32 ULID helper. Maps to REPLY_IO_GENERATE_ULID. There is no Reply.io HTTP path.
No request block; overlay src/actions.ts supplies the handler. Optional seed SHA-256(reply-io:ulid:${seed}) first 16 bytes makes the value deterministic.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Validate the Reply.io API key with GET /v3/whoami.

users.list.title: List team users
users.list.description: List Reply.io team users via GET /v3/whoami/team-users.

contacts.list.title: List contacts
contacts.list.description: List Reply.io contacts with optional top/skip pagination and exact email lookup.

contacts.search.title: Search contacts by email
contacts.search.description: Look up Reply.io contacts by exact email via GET /v3/contacts?email=.

contacts.get.title: Get contact
contacts.get.description: Get one Reply.io contact by id.

contacts.create.title: Create contact
contacts.create.description: Create a Reply.io contact. Official v3 accepts any profile fields; provide email or a LinkedIn URL.

contacts.update.title: Update contact
contacts.update.description: Patch a Reply.io contact by id. Omitted fields stay unchanged.

contacts.delete.title: Delete contact
contacts.delete.description: Delete one Reply.io contact by id.

contacts.move_to_sequence.title: Move contact to sequence
contacts.move_to_sequence.description: Enroll a contact in a sequence. Empty 204 on success.

contacts.statuses.title: Get contact statuses
contacts.statuses.description: Get a contact's opt-out, call, meeting, and per-sequence statuses.

contacts.set_status.title: Set contact sequence status
contacts.set_status.description: Set contacts to active, paused, finished, or outOfOffice across sequences they are in.

contacts.clear_opt_out.title: Clear contact opt-out
contacts.clear_opt_out.description: Clear the opted-out flag on contacts via POST /v3/contacts/set-opted-out.

sequences.list.title: List sequences
sequences.list.description: List Reply.io sequences with optional top/skip pagination and name filter.

sequences.get.title: Get sequence
sequences.get.description: Get one Reply.io sequence by id.

sequences.start.title: Start sequence
sequences.start.description: Start a new or paused Reply.io sequence.

sequences.archive.title: Archive sequence
sequences.archive.description: Archive a paused Reply.io sequence without permanently deleting it.

sequences.delete.title: Delete sequence
sequences.delete.description: Delete a Reply.io sequence by id. Contacts remain in the account.

sequences.steps.list.title: List sequence steps
sequences.steps.list.description: List every step in a Reply.io sequence.

sequences.steps.create.title: Create sequence step
sequences.steps.create.description: Add a step to a sequence. type selects email, linkedIn, call, sms, whatsApp, zapier, task, or condition.

sequences.steps.get.title: Get sequence step
sequences.steps.get.description: Get one sequence step by sequence id and step_id.

sequences.contacts.state.title: List sequence contacts with state
sequences.contacts.state.description: List contacts in a sequence with optional CurrentStep, LastStepCompletedAt, and Status columns.

sequences.contacts.remove.title: Remove contact from sequence
sequences.contacts.remove.description: Remove one contact from a sequence. Empty 204 on success.

sequences.contacts.remove_bulk.title: Bulk remove contacts from sequence
sequences.contacts.remove_bulk.description: Remove several contacts from a sequence in one call.

email_accounts.list.title: List email accounts
email_accounts.list.description: List Reply.io email accounts with optional top/skip pagination and my=true for the current user.

email_accounts.connect_gmail.title: Connect Gmail account
email_accounts.connect_gmail.description: Start Gmail OAuth. Official GET /v3/email-accounts/connect/gmail returns 302 Location to Google's consent screen.

email_accounts.connect_office365.title: Connect Office 365 account
email_accounts.connect_office365.description: Start Office 365 / Exchange OAuth. Official GET /v3/email-accounts/connect/office-365 returns 302 Location to Microsoft's consent screen.

email_accounts.list_disconnected.title: List disconnected email accounts
email_accounts.list_disconnected.description: Filter email accounts to connectionStatus disconnected.

email_accounts.update.title: Update email account
email_accounts.update.description: Patch an email account. Send only the official nested sections to change.

email_accounts.delete.title: Delete email account
email_accounts.delete.description: Delete one Reply.io email account by id.

contact_lists.list.title: List contact lists
contact_lists.list.description: List Reply.io contact lists with optional top/skip pagination and name search.

schedules.delete.title: Delete schedule
schedules.delete.description: Delete a Reply.io sending schedule by id.

ulid.generate.title: Generate ULID
ulid.generate.description: Generate a Crockford-base32 ULID. Optional seed makes the value deterministic. This is a local Composio helper, not a Reply.io HTTP API.
